finding: A modified nonhuman primate model of HIE incorporating UCO and postnatal hypoxic episodes produced brain injury patterns consistent with those seen in human neonates after severe hypoxic-ischemic insults, making it a promising model for studying HIE.
mod_finding: This study used cesarean section delivery for all subjects (both those exposed to umbilical cord occlusion and the control) and did not investigate its association with outcomes.
